doc.title: Anat Cohen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2021

title: Learning to hang, advice from a Berklee teacher
summary: A Berklee teacher told her she had to learn how to hang; she still calls it a work in progress.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: It’s the hang, which is part of what we do, right? It’s like I always say this anecdote, there was this teacher at Berklee, a guy who was always busy and like running — no I’ve got to go do homework, I’ve got to go do this, I’ve got to go — and then the teacher told me, “Anat, you’ve got to learn how to hang.” And I’m like okay. So — a work in progress.
It’s good. I like the hang.
